required_content: entry points to all required routes
links to related people, spacecraft, artifacts

states.requirement: No learning path is selected; all three choices remain understandable and actionable.
One choice is visibly and programmatically selected, its recommended sequence is available, and the visitor can continue.
Changing the selection updates the recommended sequence without losing route access.
The visitor can return to the unselected state.
A mission milestone exposes its full summary and related records; close and focus behavior are defined.
An artifact exposes description and connected mission events; close and focus behavior are defined.
The experience remains understandable and complete with reduced motion requested.

requirements: usable at 320 CSS px viewport width
touch targets at least 44 by 44 CSS px where applicable
selected and expanded states remain visible without hover

link_behavior.internal: Required routes must work when loaded directly and through in-product navigation.
link_behavior.external: Source links may open external NASA resources and must be distinguishable. The implementation must remain complete if those resources are unavailable.
